strategy.notes: 40-man raid: 3 tanks, 7 healers, 30 dps. P1 ground (100-65%): tank pulls and backs Onyxia to the rear wall; dps hold until she is against it. Tail Sweep: stay clear of her tail. P2 air (65-40%): she flies to one of 8 fixed spots; on Deep Breath move to the sides of her facing; otherwise spread 8 yds (Fireball splash). P3 ground (40-0%): Bellowing Roar fear; whelp adds need an off-tank; lava cracks. Spell ids and room geometry unconfirmed: doc/onyxia-fight-notes.md.
